The second copies the explicit care-timing input; the project also checks qualifying-person/disability applicability and infers timing outside the age13 boundary. The input refers to care included on Form2441 for this qualifying person. With a fully specified consistent applicability/timing answer the age-at-care reading agrees. Extra questions, partial-input execution and answers for excluded/nonqualifying people are not claimed equivalent. This does not resolve the other model IR defects or lift the BUG-0129 qualification hold.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the returned h_qr_relationship treats sibling_descendant as an unconditional listed Step4 relative and omits other even with twelve household months. The published input defines sibling_descendant as more distant descendants (for example grandnieces and a stepsibling child); listed nieces/nephews are already in sibling. i1040gi (2025) p.19 Step4 requires the all-year household condition for these other relationships; p501 p.19 excludes foster parents from listed parents. On the saved seven-month distant-relative case the project gives ODC false/$0, the actual model gives true/$500; an all-year other household member reverses that error. The actual-expression witness is .transcription/dependent-age-claude-witness.json. Untyped Count constants are an additional model IR defect (BUG-0129), not an excuse to call the trees equivalent.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the returned h_qr_relationship treats sibling_descendant as an unconditional listed Step4 relative and omits other even with twelve household months. The published input defines sibling_descendant as more distant descendants (for example grandnieces and a stepsibling child); listed nieces/nephews are already in sibling. i1040gi (2025) p.19 Step4 requires the all-year household condition for these other relationships; p501 p.19 excludes foster parents from listed parents. On the saved seven-month distant-relative case the project gives ODC false/$0, the actual model gives true/$500; an all-year other household member reverses that error. The actual-expression witness is .transcription/dependent-age-claude-witness.json. Untyped Count constants are an additional model IR defect (BUG-0129), not an excuse to call the trees equivalent.
